why: The correct answer depends on natural rubber being cis-1,4-polyisoprene, i.e. all-cis about its double bonds.
note: The chapter is certain, but its only topic row is 'Condensation Polymerisation: Nylons and Polyesters'; natural rubber is a natural addition polymer, so filing it there would be plainly wrong and there is no placeholder row to fall back on.
